transformation.scope: Private identifiers and machine coordinates are projected; claims and source byte hashes are retained.

positive_requirements: Exact current CLI/SDK and Broker product runtime binding agrees with the independently installed pure next candidate.
The Broker candidate completes the requested business output and every critical selected-resource contract.
No observed wrong owner, unmatched resource read, unintended adoption, remote consumption write, or intervention is accepted as a product success.
The normal-profile compatibility repair separately preserves complete read schema, actual dispatch, third-party ownership and UI rendering.
Accepted next source and all three daily installed generations are verified before adoption is called complete.
proof.unknown_policy: Preserve unproved absence and arbitrary-shell visibility as unknown. Positive critical contract evidence may support the stated narrow product adoption decision; a formal unknown is never relabeled as a full pass.
proof.comparison_limits: The native arm supplies a same-condition descriptive control. Its success or failure is examined independently and cannot substitute for the product critical contracts. No statistical superiority, general non-inferiority or pooled effect estimate is claimed.
proof.response_to_failure: Retain the exact failed run and actual cost; investigate the concrete product or measurement cause before any new attempt under the same standing grant.
